phase_help.alignment: Registering all frames of a series onto a common pixel grid so each star keeps the same coordinates throughout the night.
phase_help.calibration: Removing the camera signature from raw frames with master darks and flats, plus sanity gates that catch a wrong or stale master.
phase_help.comp_selection: Choosing the ensemble of constant stars for differential photometry from the MASTERSTAR pool: colour class first, then stability (LOO RMS), then distance; isolation, saturation and frame coverage are gates.
phase_help.detection: Finding stars, plate solving and the MASTERSTAR reference catalog matched to Gaia.
phase_help.export: TESS check of new variability candidates.
phase_help.extinction: Correcting for the atmosphere: second-order extinction (k2) that depends on star color and airmass, and optional color-term handling.
phase_help.observer: Your name and AAVSO identity for reports and exports. The observing site is the default LOCATION row in Database Explorer.
phase_help.paths: Where VYVAR keeps its data: the archive, the calibration library, the app database and the star catalogs. Set once after installing.
phase_help.photometry: Measuring star brightness: aperture and sky annulus, error model, light-curve outlier flags, neighbour light and the ePSF product.
phase_help.qc: Per-frame quality checks (sharpness, elongation, background, star count) and the sky-surface preprocess.
phase_help.reports: The PDF report: the HR diagram of the field and its optional online lookups (Gaia archive, SIMBAD).
phase_help.system: Machine-level behaviour: memory kept free when VYVAR sizes its parallel workers.
phase_help.trust: How VYVAR grades its own results: green / yellow / red trust from the comparison ensemble and the check star, and light-curve quality limits.

aavso_filter_map.help: Optional translation of your filter names to AAVSO filter codes for the exports (for example NoFilter -> CV). Empty = filter names are used as they are.
aavso_filter_map.label: AAVSO filter names

alignment_max_stars.help: Number of brightest stars the frame alignment matches.
alignment_max_stars.label: Stars used for alignment

annulus_inner_fwhm.help: Inner radius of the sky ring around each star.
annulus_inner_fwhm.label: Sky annulus inner radius

annulus_outer_fwhm.help: Outer radius of the sky ring around each star; must be larger than the inner radius.
annulus_outer_fwhm.label: Sky annulus outer radius

aperture_fwhm_factor.help: Base aperture radius in FWHM, the same for every star of a frame.
aperture_fwhm_factor.label: Aperture radius

apply_color_term.help: auto: apply the colour term when it is measured well; on: always; off: keep the instrumental system.
apply_color_term.label: Colour term

archive_root.help: Folder of the observation archive (raw and processed drafts).
archive_root.label: Archive

auto_fwhm_enabled.help: Set the FWHM limit for bad frames from the seeing of the night itself instead of a fixed number.
auto_fwhm_enabled.label: Night FWHM limit from the data

auto_fwhm_k_factor.help: Frames with FWHM above median + k x robust sigma of the night are marked as bad seeing.
auto_fwhm_k_factor.label: Night FWHM limit k

calibration_library_root.help: Folder of the master darks and flats (by camera, binning and temperature).
calibration_library_root.label: Calibration library

calibration_master_ccd_temp_tolerance_c.help: Largest difference of sensor temperature between a master dark and the light frames it may calibrate.
calibration_master_ccd_temp_tolerance_c.label: Dark temperature tolerance

comp_color_tiers.help: Colour classes 1-3: largest |BP-RP| difference between comparison star and target. Selection takes the first class with enough comparison stars and orders them by scatter, colour and distance.
comp_color_tiers.label: Colour classes

comp_max_delta_bprp.help: Colour limit after classes 1-3. Wider only for very red targets when too few comparison stars exist.
comp_max_delta_bprp.label: Largest colour difference

comp_max_slope_mmag_hr.help: Comparison stars drifting faster than this are rejected.
comp_max_slope_mmag_hr.label: Comparison drift limit

comp_catalog_offset_max_mag.help: Exclude a comparison star whose catalogue minus measured magnitude differs from the other comparison stars by more than this (replaced from the reserve); 0 = off.
comp_catalog_offset_max_mag.label: Comparison catalogue offset limit

comp_trust_min_comps.help: Fewest comparison stars for green trust; fewer give yellow, never red.
comp_trust_min_comps.label: Comparison stars for green

database_path.help: The VYVAR SQLite database (drafts, equipment, telescopes, locations, results).
database_path.label: App database

detection_threshold_sigma.help: Detection limit of every star finder in VYVAR (quality check, alignment, plate solving, MASTERSTAR, per-frame catalogs), in sky sigmas.
detection_threshold_sigma.label: Star detection threshold

epsf_auto_run.help: On: the night run and RUN VYVAR also run the ePSF stage for the ePSF targets. Off: run it from the ePSF tab. Exports to AAVSO and VarAstro stay aperture photometry.
epsf_auto_run.label: Run ePSF in every night run (beta)

epsf_targets.help: Which targets ePSF measures: ALL, or VSX types, star names or catalogue ids separated by commas; * is a wildcard (for example EA, EB, EW or E*).
epsf_targets.label: ePSF targets

epsf_export_auto.help: Write the ePSF light-curve text files (BJD, delta mag, error) when an ePSF run finishes. For your own use, not an AAVSO submission.
epsf_export_auto.label: Write ePSF light-curve files

gaia_db_path.help: The local Gaia DR3 SQLite catalog: positions, magnitudes and colours for star identification, comparison stars and plate solving.
gaia_db_path.label: Gaia DR3 catalog

gs11_dilution_enabled.help: Estimate from Gaia how much light of neighbouring stars falls into each aperture.
gs11_dilution_enabled.label: Neighbour light estimate

hrd_nss_category_enabled.help: Add Gaia non-single stars (binaries) as a highlight category.
hrd_nss_category_enabled.label: HRD binaries category

hrd_online_enrich_enabled.help: Look up details of highlighted stars online: Gaia archive (temperature, gravity) and SIMBAD object type (needs internet).
hrd_online_enrich_enabled.label: HRD online details

k2_defaults_bprp.help: Optional own k2 values per band (BP-RP units); empty = the built-in literature values.
k2_defaults_bprp.label: Own k2 per band

k2_mode.help: literature: band-dependent k2 values from the literature (BP-RP units); off: no second-order extinction.
k2_mode.label: Second-order extinction

lc_quality_min_frames.help: Fewest frames for a full light-curve quality verdict.
lc_quality_min_frames.label: Light curve minimum frames

astrometry_index_dir.help: Folder of the blind plate-solving index (catalogs/build_astro_index.py). Empty = vyvar_astro_index next to the Gaia catalog. Used only when a frame has no position in its header.
astrometry_index_dir.label: Blind plate-solve index

masterdark_validity_days.help: Age after which a master dark counts as old and VYVAR asks for new darks.
masterdark_validity_days.label: Master dark valid for

masterflat_validity_days.help: Age after which a master flat counts as old and VYVAR asks for new flats.
masterflat_validity_days.label: Master flat valid for

masterstar_best_of_n.help: How many of the best frames are tried as the MASTERSTAR reference when the first choice fails.
masterstar_best_of_n.label: MASTERSTAR candidates

objects_db_path.help: The local objects catalog: AAVSO VSX variable stars and NASA Exoplanet Archive hosts, built by catalogs/objects_make.py.
objects_db_path.label: Objects catalog (VSX + exoplanets)

observer_alt_m.help: Altitude of the observing site above sea level in meters; part of the site definition used for airmass and time corrections. WAVE-B removed the config.json copy - hydrated from the LOCATION row.
observer_alt_m.label: Observer Alt M

observer_code.help: Your official AAVSO observer code, written into every AAVSO export as #OBSCODE. A warning is shown while it is empty.
observer_code.label: AAVSO observer code

observer_lat.help: Latitude of the observing site in degrees. Hydrated from the draft's LOCATION record; WAVE-B removed the config.json copy.
observer_lat.label: Observer Lat

observer_location_id.help: Not stored in config.json: the default site is the LOCATION row with IS_DEFAULT (Database Explorer); a run may choose another site on the import page or with --location-id.
observer_location_id.label: Observing site (run time)

observer_location_name.help: Human-readable name of the selected observing site (e.g. Jirny, Dablice). WAVE-B removed the config.json copy - hydrated from the LOCATION row.
observer_location_name.label: Observer Location Name

observer_lon.help: Longitude of the observing site in degrees; hydrated from the LOCATION row (WAVE-B removed the config.json copy).
observer_lon.label: Observer Lon

observer_name.help: Your full name, printed in reports and exports.
observer_name.label: Observer name

osc_channel_binning.help: Colour (OSC) cameras only: N x N binning of each colour channel after the Bayer split. The total scale against the raw mosaic is 2 x N.
osc_channel_binning.label: OSC channel binning

per_frame_mp_reserve_ram_gb.help: Memory left free per parallel worker when VYVAR sizes the number of workers.
per_frame_mp_reserve_ram_gb.label: RAM kept free per worker

per_frame_sat_min_clean_frac.help: A target is measured only when at least this fraction of its frames is unsaturated.
per_frame_sat_min_clean_frac.label: Unsaturated frames needed

phase01_comparison_max_comp_rms.help: Upper limit of a comparison star's leave-one-out scatter; the limit used is the smaller of this and k x photon noise.
phase01_comparison_max_comp_rms.label: Comparison scatter limit

phase01_comparison_min_frames_frac.help: Fraction of the frames a comparison star must be measured on.
phase01_comparison_min_frames_frac.label: Comparison frame coverage

phase01_comparison_n_comp_max.help: Largest comparison ensemble; the gain from more stars levels off around 6-8.
phase01_comparison_n_comp_max.label: Most comparison stars

phase01_comparison_n_comp_min.help: Comparison stars wanted per target; the colour classes widen until this many are found.
phase01_comparison_n_comp_min.label: Fewest comparison stars

preprocess_sky_surface_order.help: Order of the smooth sky surface subtracted before photometry: 0 = constant, 1 = plane, 2 = gentle 2D gradient.
preprocess_sky_surface_order.label: Sky background surface order

project_root.help: VYVAR installation root; derived from the code location, never edit.
project_root.label: Project Root

qc_after_calibrate_enabled.help: Measure per-frame quality (FWHM, elongation, sky, star count) right after calibration.
qc_after_calibrate_enabled.label: Quality check after calibration

qc_preprocess_workers.help: Number of parallel preprocessing workers; computed from CPU/RAM at startup, overridable by the VYVAR_PARALLEL_WORKERS environment variable.
qc_preprocess_workers.label: QC Preprocess Workers

save_lightcurve_png.help: Also write PNG pictures of the light curves and field map during the run (the app draws its own charts without them).
save_lightcurve_png.label: Save light-curve PNG files

comp_isolation_fwhm.help: A candidate with a catalogue neighbour closer than this is treated as a blend and not used.
comp_isolation_fwhm.label: Comparison isolation

snr_min.help: Faint limit for targets, comparison and check stars: below this aperture SNR a star is not measured, and a frame where the target falls below it is not exported. 10 = 0.11 mag.
snr_min.label: Minimum SNR

tess_enabled.help: On: the night run checks TESS data of every new variability candidate and the report shows it. Off: TESS stays available by hand in the Variability tab.
tess_enabled.label: TESS check of new candidates

transient_search_enabled.help: On: the field variability search also looks for new sources on every frame (novae, supernovae, outbursts), lists stars brighter than Gaia predicts, and names the minor planets and comets in the field (MPC orbit files MPCORB.DAT.gz / CometEls.txt and the OpenNGC galaxy list NGC.csv in the catalogue folder, when present). Takes about 1 s per frame more. Off: none of this runs.
transient_search_enabled.label: Search for transients and minor bodies

vsx_out_of_scope_types.help: VSX variability types that are not measured automatically (for example ROT). Exact type match, also with the ':' uncertainty mark; manually added targets are always measured. These stars stay excluded from the comparison stars.
vsx_out_of_scope_types.label: VSX types not measured
